headings.instructions: Use Sora for all titles and headings. Import via Google Fonts in index.html or CSS.

body.instructions: Use Inter for all body text, paragraphs, and small labels.

colors.instructions: Strictly adhere to this color palette. Avoid pure black or random grays; use the deep graphite (#0B0D12) as the foundation. No other vibrant colors besides Electric Blue and Cyan.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use moderate glassmorphism for the floating header and specific overlays: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0D12]/70. Ensure a thin solid border (e.g., border-white/10) to define the edge.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Apply a subtle primary-to-secondary gradient for the word 'CRESCIMENTO' in the hero and the Final CTA band. Ensure gradients are smooth (from-[#0066FF] to-[#00D1C2]).
visual_enhancers.borders: Use very thin, subtle borders (1px border-white/5 or border-white/10) on cards to define shape without heavy shadows.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Create organic blue/cyan lighting using large, highly blurred absolutely positioned divs (e.g., bg-[#0066FF]/20 blur-[100px]) behind key sections like the Hero and Solutions.
visual_enhancers.3d_elements: Discrete 3D abstract shapes can be used as background images. No complex 3D libraries required; rely on the provided abstract images.

layouts.spacing: Use generous padding for sections (py-20 to py-32). Keep the design breathing. Do not cramp elements.
layouts.header: Capsule floating fixed header. Use 'fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full px-6 py-3'. Must contain logo, nav links, and a WhatsApp CTA.
layouts.hero: Typographic, centralized. H1 should be massive ('text-5xl md:text-7xl'). The word 'CRESCIMENTO.' must have the gradient text effect. Background should have abstract tech visuals and glows.
layouts.cards: For the 8 Solutions and 4 Differentiators, use grid layouts. Cards should use the 'surface' color (#111827) with subtle borders, displaying a premium technological feel. Hover effects should slightly lift the card and tint the border to primary.
layouts.timeline: 4-step process. Use a vertical connecting line on mobile, turning horizontal on desktop. Clean typography with subtle numbered indicators.
layouts.founder_section: Must use an elegant photo placeholder frame. ABSOLUTELY NO faces or fake generated people. Use one of the abstract dark cyan/blue images or a stylized monogram frame instead.
layouts.cta_band: Full width, gradient background (Electric Blue to Cyan). Use dark text (#0B0D12) for maximum contrast. No emojis.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use simple HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (sections, flex, grid). If complex interactives are needed, use shadcn/ui components (js version). Do not build complex accessible components from scratch. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

image_urls.description: Blue and purple lines of light - digital interface style for the hero abstract background.
Teal curved 3D wallpaper. Can be used as a subtle background for the 'Founder' placeholder frame or 'About' section.
Abstract blue glowing dots forming wave patterns. Great for the timeline or positioning sections background overlay.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text over #0B0D12 and #111827 has a high contrast ratio. Gradient text must also be legible.
accessibility.testing: All key functional elements MUST have data-testid. E.g., data-testid='whatsapp-cta', data-testid='solution-card'.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid dark backgrounds.
Don't make generic centered layouts (except the hero which is explicitly requested). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) but NEVER use a completely transparent background for floating elements over content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NO emojis, NO prices, NO fake numbers/clients/testimonials. STRICTLY NO faces or people.
